description: Breach Hydrographs and Sensitivity Analysis for Tanahu Hydropower Project (Base and Worst Case) is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Bishnu Dutta Kandel. This dataset contains breach hydrographs and sensitivity analysis for the Tanahu Hydropower Project, under Base Case and Worst Case scenarios. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 44503274 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
